The corrected stable-signature closure reaches EmbeddingSpace.truncation and TruncationPolicy through the ONNX registered result. A compiled outside-package probe confirms EmbeddingSpace.of accepts and retains KeepHead(-1), KeepTail(-1), and zero-token policies. The enum describes what a provider does with long input, but no positive token-bound check exists in this factory. The current ONNX runtime constructs Reject, so no actual ONNX execution defect is established by this probe.
Acceptance: define the admissible token-bound contract and refuse invalid declarations at construction/admission; test head/tail, zero, negative, positive and overflow-relevant limits, with a compiled guard mutation. Preserve identity for admitted recipes. Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/stability-audit-20261014/construction-probes/TruncationProbe.scala and TruncationProbe.log. FOLLOW-UP for current runtime qualification; BLOCK before claiming all reached recipes checked in a stable release.
